title: 5-toubun no Hanayome 5-shuunen Kinen PV
content:
Back in the day, this would have had me excited to the roof.
Celebrating the fifth anniversary of this beloved series with a whole event, this being the promotional video for it, and even teasing special episodes 3, 4, and 5 that would come later on. I would be a holiday in the fandom as they have it.

I'm not going to stall for more, just go and watch it, it's only a few seconds and I believe, publicly available on YouTube. Especially if you are missing the cast so much that you want to hear more of their delicate voices. And oh, Futaro just hanging on there.

Overall: 6.62/10.
